knight.name: Knight
knight.description: A cheap, sturdy melee tank that holds the front line.

archers.name: Archers
archers.description: Two ranged archers that can hit both ground and air targets.

musketeer.name: Musketeer
musketeer.description: A long-range shooter with solid damage against troops and towers.

skeletons.name: Skeletons
skeletons.description: Three fragile skeletons that delay enemies and act as distraction.

giant.name: Giant
giant.description: A tank that ignores troops and marches straight at buildings and towers.

mini_pekka.name: Mini P.E.K.K.A
mini_pekka.description: A fast single-target fighter with enormous damage per hit.

hog_rider.name: Hog Rider
hog_rider.description: A fast runner that jumps the river and only attacks buildings and towers.

valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
valkyrie.description: A durable fighter that deals area damage around herself.

baby_dragon.name: Baby Dragon
baby_dragon.description: A flying dragon that lobs splash fireballs.

balloon.name: Balloon
balloon.description: A flying balloon that only attacks buildings and explodes when destroyed.

witch.name: Witch
witch.description: A caster that fires magic and periodically summons skeletons.

prince.name: Prince
prince.description: A knight that charges after building distance for bonus damage.

bandit.name: Bandit
bandit.description: An assassin that dashes forward and strikes before being noticed.

royal_ghost.name: Royal Ghost
royal_ghost.description: A ghost that turns invisible for periods and reappears to attack.

fisherman.name: Fisherman
fisherman.description: A fisherman who throws his hook to pull enemies toward him.

mega_knight.name: Mega Knight
mega_knight.description: A legendary tank that deals landing damage and leaps onto enemies.

electro_giant.name: Electro Giant
electro_giant.description: A giant that only attacks buildings and reflects part of incoming damage.

goblin_giant.name: Goblin Giant
goblin_giant.description: A giant that ignores troops and releases spear goblins when he dies.

lava_hound.name: Lava Hound
lava_hound.description: A flying hound that only attacks buildings and splits into pups on death.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: A fiery bird that rises from its ashes after being destroyed.

inferno_dragon.name: Inferno Dragon
inferno_dragon.description: A flying dragon whose beam ramps up damage the longer it locks on.

sparky.name: Sparky
sparky.description: A machine that charges a devastating area electric blast.

battle_ram.name: Battle Ram
battle_ram.description: A fast ram that charges buildings and releases barbarians when destroyed.

ice_wizard.name: Ice Wizard
ice_wizard.description: A wizard who deals area damage and slows enemies.

electro_wizard.name: Electro Wizard
electro_wizard.description: A wizard who fires chain lightning and stuns his targets.

guards.name: Guards
guards.description: Three shielded guards that absorb damage before falling.

royal_recruits.name: Royal Recruits
royal_recruits.description: Six shielded recruits that can be deployed anywhere.

wall_breakers.name: Wall Breakers
wall_breakers.description: Two explosive skeletons that sacrifice themselves against buildings.

cannon_cart.name: Cannon Cart
cannon_cart.description: A mobile cannon that becomes a cannon tower when destroyed.

battle_healer.name: Battle Healer
battle_healer.description: A healer who restores nearby allies and heals on every hit.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: An area damage spell with great value against groups.

arrows.name: Arrows
arrows.description: A rain of arrows that covers a wide area and clears fragile troops.

zap.name: Zap
zap.description: An instant shock that briefly stuns and hits several targets.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.description: A powerful bolt that stuns and strikes the most valuable targets in the area.

rocket.name: Rocket
rocket.description: A massive damage rocket with a small radius, strong against towers.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: A toxic cloud that deals continuous damage for several seconds.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.description: Freezes enemy troops and buildings for a few seconds.

tornado.name: Tornado
tornado.description: A tornado that pulls troops to its center and deals light damage.

log.name: The Log
log.description: A log that rolls across the arena, pushing and crushing ground troops.

graveyard.name: Graveyard
graveyard.description: A graveyard that continuously summons skeletons in an area.

rage.name: Rage
rage.description: Rage that increases allies' movement and attack speed.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.description: An earthquake that deals continuous damage, slows troops and wrecks buildings.

cannon.name: Cannon
cannon.description: A cheap defensive tower with good damage against ground troops.

tesla.name: Tesla
tesla.description: An electric tower that hits both ground and air targets.

inferno_tower.name: Inferno Tower
inferno_tower.description: A tower whose damage ramps up against tough single targets.

bomb_tower.name: Bomb Tower
bomb_tower.description: A tower that lobs area bombs at ground troops.

mortar.name: Mortar
mortar.description: A long-range mortar that bombards groups from afar.

goblin_hut.name: Goblin Hut
goblin_hut.description: A hut that periodically summons spear goblins.

tombstone.name: Tombstone
tombstone.description: A tombstone that spawns skeletons and releases more when destroyed.

elixir_collector.name: Elixir Collector
elixir_collector.description: A collector that generates extra elixir over time.
